title: Processing human brain tissue for population-scale SQK-LSK114 Oxford Nanopore sequencing
author: Jackson Mingle
materials: Lysis/Binding Plate: 50 µL Buffer BL3 Plate
600 µL Buffer CW1 per well Plate
600 µL Buffer CW2 per well Plate

Place the following supplies on dry ice and allow to chill for 00:10:00 prior to use: Sterile weigh boats Razor blades Spatulas Tweezers Empty 2 mL Eppendorf Protein LoBind tubes - labeled with sample ID Cooling block Note: Reusable metal tools (spatulas, tweezers) must be cleaned with 70% ethanol, RNaseZap, and distilled water prior to use. Apply a layer of plastic wrap to the dry ice and place metal tools on the plastic wrap to chill them prior to use.
Don all necessary protective equipment prior to setting up the biosafety cabinet: Disposable lab coat Gloves (2 pairs) Face shield or mask

Complete the following preparation steps: Place cooling block for 2 mL tubes on dry ice for 00:10:00 Place TissueLyser adapters in -20 °C freezer Place Buffer CT on ice Chill centrifuge to 4 °C Set ThermoMixer to 55 °C Turn on the UV light in the KingFisher Apex system for 01:00:00 Wipe down all surfaces, pipettes, and magnetic racks with 70% ethanol and RNaseZap
Using the Qiagen bead dispenser, add one 5mm stainless steel bead to each sample. Note: To prevent brain tissue from flying out of the tube, dispense bead into tube cap, then close the tube.

Thaw the following reagents at room temperature: Sequencing Buffer (SB) Library Solution (LIS) Flow Cell Tether (FCT) Flow Cell Flush (FCF) Elution Buffer (EB) Mix by vortexing, spin down, and place on ice.

Thaw the following reagents at room temperature: Sequencing Buffer (SB) Library Solution (LIS) Flow Cell Tether (FCT) Flow Cell Flush (FCF) Elution Buffer (EB) Wash Diluent (DIL) Mix by vortexing, spin down, and place on ice.
Pause the sequencing run in MinKNOW.
Wait 00:10:00 before resuming sequencing run in MinKNOW.

Create a new protocol using the BluePippin software and select the cassette type: Click the "Protocol Editor" tab Click the "Cassette Type" folder icon Click "+" icon next to "0.75% Agarose Dye-Free" Select "10kb High Pass Plus Marker U1" Click "SELECT" Note: The standard protocol used is "10kb High Pass Plus Marker U1". If samples require more aggressive size selection following analysis of post-shearing Femto Pulse traces, "15kb High Pass Plus Marker U1" or "20kb High Pass Plus Marker U1" protocols can be run instead.
Gently remove the cassette from the optical nest.

steps.title: Tissue Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare and weigh frozen brain tissue samples while maintaining cold temperatures to prevent thawing.

substeps.instruction: Obtain tissue samples from -80 °C freezer and place on dry ice.
Wipe biosafety cabinet with 70% ethanol, RNaseZap, and distilled water; ensure scale is level.
Pour frozen brain tissue onto a sterile weigh boat on a cooling block.
Cut brain tissue firmly using a razor blade.
Weigh a labeled empty 2 mL Eppendorf Protein LoBind tube and tare the scale.
Transfer the cut piece of brain tissue to the tube and record the weight (typically 35-45 mg for most regions, 8-10 mg for cerebellum).
Immediately return samples to dry ice.

steps.title: Tissue Homogenization
steps.instruction: Homogenize the brain tissue using a TissueLyser.

substeps.instruction: Load samples into the middle rows of balanced TissueLyser adapters removed from -20 °C freezer.
Add 750 µL cold Buffer CT, ensuring all tissue chunks are submerged.
Add 60 µL Buffer CS.
Run TissueLyser at 25 Hz for 00:00:40.
Add 1 mL cold Buffer CT and pipette-mix ~10x with a wide-bore P1000 tip to resuspend the pellet.
Centrifuge at 6,000 x g for 00:05:00 at 4 °C to pellet homogenate; discard supernatant carefully.

steps.title: DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from the homogenate using a KingFisher Apex instrument.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL TE pH 8 and 20 µL Proteinase K to the pellet.
Centrifuge at 6,000 x g for 00:05:00 at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Incubate on ThermoMixer for 00:30:00 at 55 °C and 900 rpm, then spin down.
Pipette-mix ~15x with a wide-bore P200 tip.
Add 100 µL Buffer CLE3, then add 20 µL RNase A and pipette-mix 5x with a wide-bore P200 tip.
Incubate for 01:00:00 at 55 °C and 900 rpm in Thermomixer, then spin down.
Add 50 µL Buffer SB, vortex for 00:00:10 at maximum speed, and spin down.

Prepare KingFisher Apex plates: Plate 1 (Lysis/Binding: 50 µL Buffer BL3), Plate 2 (Nanobind Storage: one 3 mm disk/well), Plate 3 & 4 (Wash 1: 600 µL Buffer CW1), Plate 5 & 6 (Wash 2: 600 µL Buffer CW2), Plate 7 (Elution: 100 µL Buffer EB), Plate 8 (Tip Plate).
Transfer samples into the Lysis/Binding Plate (total volume ~250 µL).
Run the Brain_Tissue_Nanobind_HT_Apex script on KingFisher Apex with 96 deep-well magnetic head and heating block.
When prompted (~12 min), add 300 µL isopropanol gently to the Lysis/Binding Plate wells and resume.
When prompted, transfer eluate from the Elution Plate to 1.5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tubes, including residual volume from the tip comb.

steps.title: DNA Quantification and Initial Sizing
steps.instruction: Quantify the extracted DNA and check the size range.

substeps.instruction: Quantify DNA using Qubit Flex Fluorometer with Qubit 1x dsDNA BR Assay (1 µL DNA per measurement).
Optional: Size on Agilent Femto Pulse System with Genomic DNA 165 kb kit (expected size >60 kb).
Optional: Quantify using NanoDrop 8000 (2 µL DNA per measurement).
If tissue debris remains, centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 00:05:00 at room temperature and transfer supernatant to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: DNA Shearing
steps.instruction: Shear DNA using the Megaruptor 3 to achieve targeted N50s of 25-35 kb.

substeps.instruction: Prepare DNA in 100 µL Buffer EB at a concentration ≤ 150 ng/µL in a Megaruptor 3 shearing tube.
Store at 4 °C until ready.
Prepare the Megaruptor 3 DNA Fluid+ shearing syringe (compressed plunger, snug fit).
Run samples on Megaruptor 3 at speed 45 for a total of 2 runs, entering the accurate volume (100 µL) and concentration.
Remove samples and the syringe, ensuring the plunger is fully depressed to recover all volume.
Let eluate rest overnight at room temperature to allow DNA to solubilize.
Following overnight rest, hand-shear 10x with a 1 mL Luer-Lock syringe and 1.5" needle; remove plunger to ensure no sample is left behind.

steps.title: Post-Shearing Quality Control
steps.instruction: Verify the size of the sheared DNA.

substeps.instruction: Size on Agilent Femto Pulse System with Genomic DNA 165 kb kit (expected range ~25-40 kb).
Store at 4 °C (or -80 °C for long-term) until size selection.

steps.title: DNA Size Selection
steps.instruction: Perform size selection using the BluePippin system.

substeps.instruction: Prepare BluePippin cassette: remove adhesive strips, inspect for bubbles/delamination, and insert into optical nest.
Fill buffer reservoirs (ensure >50% full) and remove 85 µL buffer from sample wells.
Add 11 µL 2X Loading Solution to DNA samples, mix, and spin down.
Load 85 µL of sample into sample wells and 40 µL of marker into the marker well.
Calibrate optical sensors and perform Continuity Test.
Configure run: BP Start = 10000, select reference lane, and check 'End Run when Elution is Completed'.
Run the system and wait 30-45 minutes after completion before removing samples.
Remove samples (~80 µL) from elution modules using a P200 pipette; optionally rinse with TE+0.1% Tween 20 for higher yield.
Size on Agilent Femto Pulse (expected range ~24-40 kb, DQN > 9.8).
Store at 4 °C; minimum 2.5 µg DNA required for library prep.

steps.title: Library Preparation (Manual or Automated)
steps.instruction: Prepare the sequencing library using the SQK-LSK114 kit.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 2.5 µg DNA in 48 µL nuclease-free water in a 0.2 mL thin-walled PCR tube.

Add 12 µL DNA repair enzyme master mix (composed of 3.5 µL NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Buffer, 3.5 µL Ultra II End-Prep Reaction Buffer, 2 µL NEBNext FFPE DNA Repair Mix, and 3 µL Ultra II End-Prep Enzyme Mix).
Incubate at 20 °C for 00:30:00, then 65 °C for 00:05:00 in a thermocycler.

Perform bead clean-up: add 60 µL resuspended AMPure XP beads, incubate 00:30:00 at RT, remove supernatant on magnetic rack, wash twice with 200 µL 80% ethanol, dry for 30s, and elute with 26 µL Elution Buffer.
Add 40 µL ligation enzyme master mix (25 µL Ligation Buffer, 10 µL Quick T4 DNA Ligase, 5 µL Ligation Adapter).
Incubate for 00:20:00 at 37 °C and 450 rpm in Thermomixer.
Perform second bead clean-up: add 45 µL AMPure XP beads, incubate 00:30:00 at RT, remove supernatant, wash with 250 µL Short Fragment Buffer (SFB), dry for 30s, and elute with 26 µL Elution Buffer.
Transfer 60 µL of eluate to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube.
Quantify using Qubit Flex Fluorometer with Qubit 1X dsDNA HS Assay (1 µL DNA per measurement).
Store at 4 °C (or -80 °C); minimum 750 ng required for loading.

steps.title: PromethION Flow Cell Loading
steps.instruction: Prime the flow cell and load the prepared DNA library.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate flow cells at room temperature for 00:20:00; check for condensation on pins.
Perform flow cell check (starting pore count must be >6500).
Prepare priming mix (1170 µL Flow Cell Flush + 30 µL Flow Cell Tether) and wash mix (398 µL Wash Diluent + 2 µL Wash Mix).
Load 400 µL wash mix, then 500 µL priming mix into the inlet port, removing air bubbles by drawing back 20-30 µL via the inlet port.
Prepare 300 ng DNA library in 32 µL Elution Buffer; mix gently by pipetting 5x.
Load 200 µL of library into the inlet port.
Load an additional 500 µL of priming mix, remove air bubbles, and seal the inlet port with the valve and light shield.

steps.title: Sequencing Run
steps.instruction: Initiate and monitor the sequencing run in MinKNOW.

substeps.instruction: Wait 00:10:00 before initiating the run.
In MinKNOW: select SQK-LSK114-XL kit, fast basecalling model, 72 or 96 hour run time, raw reads output .POD5, and minimum Q score of 8.
Monitor pore occupancy and scan results in the first hour; troubleshoot by re-inserting flow cell or recovering library if necessary.
Expected output: ~90-100 Gb with N50 ~20-30 kb after 72 hours and 3 loads.
